problems_and_friction: clan read subcommand syntax requires a subcommand before the file path — initial attempts with `clan read <file> <section>` failed with 'unrecognized subcommand'. Corrected quickly.

Output schema is still a bare 'type: object' with no field constraints — synthesizer had full discretion on data shape. This is the correct design for an open-ended pipeline but means no schema enforcement of the synthesis output structure.
hop-02 receipt was invaluable — it documented the pack-html argument order (PARENT then HTML), preventing the same positional error that burned tokens in hop-01.
No friction on the pack-html invocation itself. First attempt succeeded on correct argument order.
The TOON-encoded agent context from clan read agent contained all data from both previous hops in one call — no need to separately read data.yaml or decision-chain.yaml.
context_understood: Hop 3 of 3 (final synthesizer) in a multi-agent market entry assessment pipeline for Brightline Logistics entering the German logistics market. Hop 1 (market-size analyst) produced TAM €127bn / SAM €31bn / 4.2% CAGR analysis, competitive landscape (DHL 18%, DB Schenker 14%, Rhenus 9%), and recommended Warehousing & Fulfillment + Last-Mile as entry segment with 22-month break-even at €4.5m Year 1 revenue. Hop 2 (risk analyst) completed five-category risk matrix (MEDIUM-HIGH overall; HIGH for regulatory and competitive; MEDIUM for operational, financial, macro) with 15 discrete risks and mitigations. As synthesizer, role is to integrate all findings, issue a final PROCEED/HOLD verdict with rationale, produce a phased entry roadmap, and render a publication-quality full-HTML synthesis document suitable for board review.
